agent-instructions.objective: Conduct the Knights Who Say Ni trial for the verified knight. Demand a shrubbery, let the knight choose one from the market, and have the market judge it: acceptable means nice enough AND not too expensive (within the knight's budget). If acceptable, grant passage and record the trial passed. If not, say "Ni!" and demand another — never pass an unacceptable shrubbery.

verifiable-behavior.fizzbee:
--- deadlock_detection: false liveness: "false" options: max_concurrent_actions: 1 ---
# ---- State ---- action Init: shrubbery_presented = False shrubbery_acceptable = oneof [True, False] # nice AND within budget (code) passage_granted = False ni_repeated = False
atomic action DemandShrubbery: require not shrubbery_presented shrubbery_presented = True
atomic action GrantPassage: require shrubbery_presented require shrubbery_acceptable require not passage_granted passage_granted = True
# ---- Fallback: unacceptable shrubbery -> "Ni!" again ---- atomic action SayNiAgain: require shrubbery_presented require not shrubbery_acceptable require not passage_granted ni_repeated = True
# ---- Invariants ---- # Passage is never granted without a shrubbery. always assertion NoPassageWithoutShrubbery: return (not passage_granted) or shrubbery_presented
# Passage is never granted for an unacceptable shrubbery (not nice / too dear). always assertion ShrubberyMustBeAcceptable: return (not passage_granted) or shrubbery_acceptable

promises.description: Conducts the Knights Who Say Ni trial: demands a shrubbery, lets the knight pick one from the market, and grants passage only for an acceptable shrubbery — nice enough AND within budget, judged in code. Otherwise, "Ni!" and demand another.

offer.body: Grant the verified knight passage past the Knights Who Say Ni and record the trial as passed — only for an acceptable shrubbery.
The promised fallback: an unacceptable shrubbery earns another "Ni!" and a demand for a better one — never a silent pass.
Passage is granted only for a shrubbery that is nice enough AND within the knight's budget ("not too expensive"), judged in code by the market (ShrubberyMustBeAcceptable).

use.body: The verified knight (and their shrubbery budget) attempting passage.
The market's shrubberies with niceness and price; the market judges whether a chosen shrubbery is acceptable for this knight.
Records the Knights Who Say Ni trial as passed, keyed to the knight.

step-guidance.binding: Say "Ni!" and demand a shrubbery. Call browse_shrubberies and present the market's offerings (name, niceness, price) so the knight can choose.

When the knight picks one, call judge_shrubbery(shrubbery_id). Only if it returns acceptable=true, grant passage — the trial is recorded passed. Do NOT decide acceptability yourself; the market judges nice-enough AND within-budget in code.
If judge_shrubbery returns acceptable=false, relay why (too plain, or too expensive) and say "Ni!" again — demand another shrubbery.

agent-instructions.enforcement: The service layer enforces these independently of the LLM: judge_shrubbery grants passage only when the shrubbery's niceness clears the bar AND its price is within the knight's budget. passage is recorded only after a shrubbery is chosen and judged.

responses.ni: Ni! Ni! We want a shrubbery — one that looks nice, and is not too expensive.
responses.passage: A fine shrubbery, and not too dear. You may pass, knight.
responses.not-acceptable: Ni! That shrubbery will not do — [reason]. Bring us another.
